full_judgment:
7. Mr. Mujibur Rahman, the learned Advocate appearing for the pre-emptor-petitioners at the very outset upon referring two decisions reported in 30 DLR 75 and 8 BLC (AD) 147 submits that admittedly homestead situated on the case land is beyond the municipal area and as such it is not exempted from the operation of section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Finally; he submits that the learned Additional District Judge erred in law in affirming the judgment of the trial Court without properly considering the facts of the case and the case made out by the petitioners and the same has occasioned failure of justice. 

 10. It appears that in this case pre-emptor himself was examined as PW-1, who in his cross-examination stated that: মাটি ফেলেছে বলতে পারবোনা। নিষেধাজ্ঞা কবে হয়েছিল তা জানিনা। 

 11. PW-2, Md. Mafizur Rahman stated his deposition that: নালিশী জমিতে ১ নং প্রতিপক্ষ খরিদের পর ঘর তুলেছে। 

 12. It also appears that pre-emptee-opposite party No.1; Yosuf Sikder was examined as OPW-I, who stated in his deposition that: “আমি নালিশী জমি ২-৩ নং প্রতিপক্ষের নিকট থেকে এক লক্ষ টাকায় ক্রয় করেছি। কেনার পরে আমি নালিশী জমিতে ৩ টি ছাপড়া ঘর, ২ টি দোচালা ঘর, রান্নাঘর, টিউবওয়েল, পাকা পায়খানা দেই এবং গাছপালা রোপন করি। জমিতে ৫০,০০০/- টাকার মাটি ভরাট করেছি। ঘর তুলতে প্রায় এক লক্ষ টাকা ব্যয় করেছি।” 

 13. OPW-2, Md. Monju Miah stated in his deposition that: “১নং প্রতিপক্ষ জমি কেনার পরে ঘরবাড়ি করে বসবাস করে। জমি বিক্রয়ের কথা অন্য শরিকরা জানে।” 

 14. OPW-3, Md. Delwar Flossain stated in his deposition that: প্রতিপক্ষ জমি কিনে ২টি ঘর, ১টি রান্নাঘর তুলে বসবাস করেন। এখানে গাছগাছালিও বুনেছেন। তিনি কিছু মাটিও ফেলেছেন। 

 "Any land used as a homestead by its owner in the rural area shall be exempted from all legal processes, including seizure, distress, attachment or sale by any officer, court or any other authority and the owner of such land shall not be divested or dispossessed of the land or evicted therefrom by any means. Provided that nothing in this section shall apply to the acquisition of such home-stead under any law." Sub-section (3) of section 2 of the said Ordinances has defined homestead thus:-"Homestead means a dwelling house without-houses, tanks and enclosures immediately connected with it covering an area of not more than one standard bigha. Provided that where such areas exceed one standard bigha the excess land shall not be deemed to be homestead."
